notes: The opening waw takes the postpositive *also* under rule 51; a waw is present in the clause, so the word is not added and the distance is not evidence against it.
*themselves* renders the verb's own reflexive voice and stays in its unit (rule 44); *with sackcloth* is rule 33's adverbial accusative.
The gapped parallel line writes no second copula, so בְ takes only *upon* (rule 34).
